vtable.extent_evidence: THREE INDEPENDENT TOOLS, because neither single-tool rule is sound in ov006. (1) Relocations: config/arm9/overlays/ov006/relocs.txt carries a relocated word at every 4-byte address from 0x0213f840 (the typeinfo pointer; 0x0213f83c is the zero offset-to-top and is NOT relocated) through 0x0213f8d4 with no gap -- but that run OVERSHOOTS by one word. 0x0213f8d4 is named data_ov006_0213f8d4 in ov006's own symbols.txt and begins a table of EIGHT-byte pairs (every following reloc is +0x8 apart, not +0x4), and its word 0x0211f040 is not a dScMgSound_c slot. This is the documented ov006 overshoot, 15 of 51 tables. (2) tools/rtti_vtables.py --own dScMgSound_c reports 36 slots, base dScMgSingle3DBase_c also 36. (3) tools/romdata_check.py check_object() on the compiled TU reports _ZTV12dScMgSound_c bytes 144, emitted 144, romExtent 144, blindWords 0, VERIFIED. All three agree: symbol extent 0x90 from the address point = 36 slots, storage 0x98 from 0x0213f83c. Corroborated by content: slot 0 at 0x0213f844 is 0x0211c984 = _ZN12dScMgSound_c13InitResourcesEv, and the last slot at 0x0213f8d0 is 0x0210a708 = _ZN19dScMgSingle3DBase_c9Virtual84Ev, which is slot 35 of the base's own 36-slot table.
